select distinct `customer` from (select * from (select CONCAT('payment:',t.id) as id,t.id as record_id,r.id as document_id,'payment' as document_source,t.transaction_ref as number,t.created_at as source_date,t.created_at as recorded_at,COALESCE(t.customer_name,r.buyer_name) as customer,COALESCE(t.customer_tin,r.buyer_tin) as customer_tin,t.transaction_type as document_type,'payment' as family,
                CASE WHEN t.status IN ('completed','paid','settled','verified','success','valid') THEN 'completed' WHEN t.status IN ('cancelled','canceled','voided','void','refunded','refund') THEN 'cancelled' WHEN t.status IN ('failed','rejected','invalid') THEN 'failed' ELSE 'pending' END as status,t.status as raw_status,t.amount,t.vat_amount as vat,t.branch,t.channel,t.payment_method,r.merchant_tin as seller_tin,1 as identity_count,NULL as original_invoice_id,'instant' as date_precision,COALESCE(r.sale_category,'regular') as sale_category,COALESCE(r.statutory_discount_amount,0) as statutory_discount_amount,COALESCE(r.vat_relief_amount,0) as vat_relief_amount,COALESCE(r.discount_amount,0) as discount_amount, CASE WHEN t.status IN ('completed','paid','settled','verified','success','valid') THEN ROUND(t.amount*100) ELSE 0 END as sales_centavos from `merchant_transactions` as `t` left join `transaction_receipts` as `r` on `r`.`id` = COALESCE(t.receipt_id,(SELECT rr.id FROM transaction_receipts rr WHERE rr.transaction_id=t.id AND rr.merchant_id=t.merchant_id ORDER BY rr.id LIMIT 1)) and `r`.`merchant_id` = `t`.`merchant_id` where `t`.`merchant_id` = ?) as `records`) as `r` where `customer` is not null and `customer` != ? order by `customer` asc limit 200

select COUNT(*) as total,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('issued','completed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as successful,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as pending,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('failed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as failed,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bir_status='acknowledged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as acknowledged,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bir_status='queued' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as queued,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bir_status IN ('blocked','uncertain','needs_review') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as attention,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN family='invoice' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as invoices,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN family IN ('receipt','supplementary') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as receipts,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN family='credit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as credit,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN family='debit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as debit,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='draft' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as drafts,COALESCE(SUM(sales_centavos),0) as total_sales_centavos from (select amount,'payment' as family,'not_submitted' as bir_status,
                CASE WHEN status IN ('completed','paid','settled','verified','success','valid') THEN 'completed' WHEN status IN ('cancelled','canceled','voided','void','refunded','refund') THEN 'cancelled' WHEN status IN ('failed','rejected','invalid') THEN 'failed' ELSE 'pending' END as status,
                CASE WHEN status IN ('completed','paid','settled','verified','success','valid') THEN ROUND(amount*100) ELSE 0 END as sales_centavos from `merchant_transactions` force index (mt_registry_summary) where `merchant_id` = ?) as `r` limit 1
select distinct `transaction_type` from `merchant_transactions` where `merchant_id` = ? and `transaction_type` is not null and `transaction_type` != ? order by `transaction_type` asc limit 200
select distinct `channel` from `merchant_transactions` where `merchant_id` = ? and `channel` is not null and `channel` != ? order by `channel` asc limit 200
select distinct `payment_method` from `merchant_transactions` where `merchant_id` = ? and `payment_method` is not null and `payment_method` != ? order by `payment_method` asc limit 200

select `record_id` from (select records.*,NULL as delivery_state,NULL as delivery_updated_at,CASE WHEN records.document_source='payment' AND records.document_id IS NULL THEN 'not_linked' ELSE 'not_submitted' END as bir_status from (select CONCAT('payment:',t.id) as id,t.id as record_id,r.id as document_id,'payment' as document_source,t.transaction_ref as number,t.created_at as source_date,t.created_at as recorded_at,COALESCE(t.customer_name,r.buyer_name) as customer,COALESCE(t.customer_tin,r.buyer_tin) as customer_tin,t.transaction_type as document_type,'payment' as family,
                CASE WHEN t.status IN ('completed','paid','settled','verified','success','valid') THEN 'completed' WHEN t.status IN ('cancelled','canceled','voided','void','refunded','refund') THEN 'cancelled' WHEN t.status IN ('failed','rejected','invalid') THEN 'failed' ELSE 'pending' END as status,t.status as raw_status,t.amount,t.vat_amount as vat,t.branch,t.channel,t.payment_method,r.merchant_tin as seller_tin,1 as identity_count,NULL as original_invoice_id,'instant' as date_precision,COALESCE(r.sale_category,'regular') as sale_category,COALESCE(r.statutory_discount_amount,0) as statutory_discount_amount,COALESCE(r.vat_relief_amount,0) as vat_relief_amount,COALESCE(r.discount_amount,0) as discount_amount, CASE WHEN t.status IN ('completed','paid','settled','verified','success','valid') THEN ROUND(t.amount*100) ELSE 0 END as sales_centavos from `merchant_transactions` as `t` left join `transaction_receipts` as `r` on `r`.`id` = COALESCE(t.receipt_id,(SELECT rr.id FROM transaction_receipts rr WHERE rr.transaction_id=t.id AND rr.merchant_id=t.merchant_id ORDER BY rr.id LIMIT 1)) and `r`.`merchant_id` = `t`.`merchant_id` where `t`.`merchant_id` = ?) as `records`) as `r` order by `source_date` desc, `record_id` desc limit 10 offset 0
select distinct `branch` from `merchant_transactions` where `merchant_id` = ? and `branch` is not null and `branch` != ? order by `branch` asc limit 200

select column_name as `name`, data_type as `type_name`, column_type as `type`, collation_name as `collation`, is_nullable as `nullable`, column_default as `default`, column_comment as `comment`, generation_expression as `expression`, extra as `extra` from information_schema.columns where table_schema = schema() and table_name = 'users' order by ordinal_position asc
